items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 4:1
items.html: Since the measure of the magnitude of the light is drawn according to the measure of the abundance of the coarseness of the screen, the coarseness and the refinement are therefore found to be of equal importance and are discerned as being mixed one with the other, so that no difference between them can be separated out or recognised. (Chapter 6, Item 3)
